## Qué cambia y por qué / What changes and why



## Lista / Checklist

- [ ] Revisé y probé todo el cambio, incluido lo generado con IA, y respondo por él. / I reviewed and tested the whole change, including anything generated with AI, and I take responsibility for it.
- [ ] Cada commit lleva mi `Signed-off-by` (DCO), que agregué yo con `git commit -s`. / Every commit carries my `Signed-off-by` (DCO), which I added myself with `git commit -s`.
- [ ] Declaré la ayuda de IA con `Assisted-by: <tool>:<model>`, o no usé IA. / I declared AI assistance with `Assisted-by: <tool>:<model>`, or I did not use AI.
- [ ] No incluí código de otra fuente sin respetar y declarar su licencia. / I did not include code from another source without respecting and declaring its license.
- [ ] Las pruebas pasan y `reuse lint` no da errores. / The tests pass and `reuse lint` reports no errors.
